dataset.split_policy: source-disjoint train/development split within half_train; half_test triple images are frozen evaluation only

published_style.embedder_and_baseline_classes: official EMBEDDER_TYPES and BASELINE_TYPES including triples

strict_holdout.embedder_and_baseline_classes: same official vocabulary/order and model shapes, but no triple training or development samples; baseline HDF5 contains singleton/double classes only
strict_holdout.selection: fixed terminal epochs; no triple evaluation before both tracks are frozen

matched_training.optimizer: original CURE Adam and learning-rate schedule per stage
matched_training.update_policy: match optimizer updates and source split across tracks; resample permitted singleton/double embedder examples for strict track without introducing triple examples
matched_training.checkpoint_policy: fixed terminal checkpoint of each stage, no test-based selection

evaluation.primary: frozen CCDD-11 half_test triple full restoration and selective restoration with verified matched targets
evaluation.output_collapse_gate: real-image finite/range/luminance and input-relative PSNR checks before full training or test export
